note: Adapted from Snyder's (1922) original description (in English) when the species was described; the alate and the soldier both have prose descriptions and measurements; the worker is not described. Measurements: alate total length 17.5 mm, dealate 8.0 mm, head length 2.00 mm, head width (including the compound eyes) 1.80 mm, compound eye long diameter 0.405 mm, pronotum length 1.30 mm and width 2.05 mm, hind tibia 1.50 mm, wing length 13.5 mm and width 4.0 mm; soldier total length 10.5—11.7 mm, head including the mandibles 4.25—4.95 mm, head without the mandibles 3.10—3.20 mm, left mandible 1.65—1.70 mm, head width 2.35—2.45 mm, pronotum length 1.25—1.45 mm and width 2.35—2.45 mm, hind tibia 1.35—1.40 mm. The OCR of the original prints the genus as Kalotermes/Koto-termes, corrected here from the context.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark chestnut-brown, darker in front than behind, not significantly longer than wide, the base rounded. At the level of the posterior margin of the compound eyes traces of a depression of the frontal gland are visible. Dorsum and margins of the head with scattered but long hairs. Compound eyes not quite circular, large and projecting, less than their own diameter from the lower (lateral) margin of the head and less than two diameters from the posterior margin. Ocelli large and elongate, set obliquely beside the compound eyes and almost touching them. Postclypeus chestnut-brown, far wider than long. Labrum paler than the head, elongate and narrowing towards the tip, the tip almost truncate, with long hairs. Antennae yellowish brown, 17—19-segmented, densely covered with long hairs; segment 1 long and thick, almost cylindrical; segment 2 shorter, elongate and club-shaped; segment 3 club-shaped, shorter than segment 2 and darker with stronger sclerotization; segment 4 rather wedge-shaped and shorter than segment 3; segment 5 longer; the terminal segment slender and almost oval. Pronotum slightly paler than the head and wider, the anterior margin deeply concave, nearly twice as wide as long, shorter than the wing buds or wing scales, the posterior part rounded and notched; margins rather densely covered with long hairs. Dorsum of the abdomen about concolorous with the pronotum, the venter paler, with long hairs. Legs yellowish brown, the tibiae darker. Wings far longer than the whole dealate adult, the radius sector with 5—7 long branches running to the costal margin and with several short branches; cubitus with 17 branches, not reaching the tip of the wing.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head colour grading from pale yellow behind to yellowish brown in front, the anterior margin more chestnut; head far longer than wide, the sides varying from short and rounded to longer and parallel, as is usual in the genus Kalotermes. Eye spot purple and elongate, set obliquely on the side of the head, its distance from the antennal fossa equal to its short diameter. Sides of the head with long scattered hairs. Labrum yellow, not significantly wider than long, the tip broadly rounded (almost truncate), with long hairs. Mandibles black with a chestnut-brown base, thick and broad at the base and pointed at the tip; left mandible with 2 pointed marginal teeth near the tip, below which are a further vestigial small tooth and a rather broad molar area; right mandible with 1 pointed marginal tooth near the middle of the mandible and another pointed tooth at the base. Antennae yellowish brown, 15-segmented, with long hairs; segment 1 long and thick, cylindrical; segment 2 shorter and club-shaped; segment 3 chestnut-brown and club-shaped (narrow at the base), longer than segment 2 but shorter than the sum of segments 4 and 5, segments 4 and 5 short and ring-like (slightly wedge-shaped); the segments becoming more slender towards the tip; the terminal segment slender and almost oval. Postmentum short, distinctly narrowed in the middle. Pronotum yellow to yellowish brown, the anterior margin deeply concave, the posterior margin almost convex but slightly notched; not wider than the head, far wider than long; lateral margins with long hairs. Abdomen dirty greyish white with a yellowish tinge, with long hairs. Legs: hind femur swollen, tibia and tarsus darker.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Type locality Kauai, Hawaii, at 915 m altitude, collected by B. P. Clark in March; holotype an alate (USNM 21566). The soldier and dealate adults were collected in the mountains of Oahu by Swezey on 21 May (month 5) 1920. The venation of the species is of the Neotermes type, while the soldier is of the Kalotermes type in its swollen hind femur and its enlarged, dark, strongly sclerotized third antennal segment; Snyder therefore regarded it as transitional between the two genera, whence the specific name connexus.
